en: How do I download all my contacts?
Can I export my customers to a CSV?

steps: Open Contacts, press Download the contacts file
The file has number, name, opted-out, marketing consent, tags and the last customer message time
edgeCases: Store owner only; staff and an operator session are refused
Every page read is audited (count only, no numbers or names)
Names that look like spreadsheet formulas are defused in the CSV
